## Key Shopify Store Stats

Every online store has different operational needs. 

Shopify apps help brands extend the platform’s core functionality, deliver a better customer experience, and move faster toward growth goals.

Over time, the Shopify App Store has grown into a broad ecosystem of tools built for nearly every ecommerce use case.

#### Key Shopify App Store Statistics

- ✓ The Shopify App Store hosts 17,600+ apps as of April 2026
- ✓ 50%+ year-over-year growth in app count
- ✓ 87% of Shopify merchants reported relying on apps to run their stores
- ✓ The average Shopify merchant installs 6 apps to optimize their stores, with some using 20-30 apps
- ✓ 12,000+ developers and vendors have published apps in the store
- ✓ Shopify app developers earned over $1B in 2024
- ✓ More than 1,200 apps carry the Built for Shopify badge
- ✓ The average Shopify app costs $58–$67 per month.

These numbers show how central apps have become to the Shopify ecosystem and why app strategy is now a business decision rather than just a technical one.

If your brand faces complex requirements, a Shopify App Development Agency can help you turn strategy into measurable growth, operational efficiency, and a superior customer experience.

## Total Number of Apps on the Shopify App Store

When evaluating the ecosystem's scale, a common question is how many Shopify stores currently drive this demand. 

The number of active Shopify stores increased to over 6.9 million worldwide, commanding approximately 30% of the U.S. eCommerce market, with gross merchandise sales reaching billions annually.

According to recent research, the typical yearly earnings of an average Shopify store amount to around $67,000, which directly influences their investment in third-party solutions.

Key takeaway

The average store within this ecosystem relies on 6 to 8 apps.

The increasing number of active apps is a direct response to the massive Shopify App Store user growth, as more than 1.75 million global merchants seek specialized tools to scale their operations.

As Shopify's growth continues and new stores launch, the number of available apps is expected to increase further:

- ✓ 17,591 active apps are currently available on the Shopify App Store (as of April 2026)
- ✓ 564 new apps were added in the last 30 days alone, driving a +51% year-over-year growth
- ✓ 12,100+ different vendors have contributed to this ecosystem, publishing 19,300+ total apps to date.

### Shopify App Store Growth Trends

As Shopify continues to evolve from a simple storefront provider into a comprehensive retail infrastructure, its app store remains the primary engine for platform innovation.

The historical growth of the Shopify App Store demonstrates a resilient upward trend, with the total number of specialized solutions reaching record levels by early 2026.

| Year | Number of Apps in Shopify App Store | YoY Growth |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2020 | ~4200 | - |
| 2021 | ~5000-6000 | +31% |
| 2022 | ~7000 | +27% |
| 2023 | 8500+ | +21% |
| 2024 | 10 309 | +21% |
| 2025 | 11 600 | +13% |
| Q1 2026 | 17 659 | +52% |

Growth is no longer limited to small businesses. 

Shopify Plus now powers over 47,600 distinct merchants, including many DTC brands, running across more than 71,000 domains. 

#### Key Insights

- ✓ This Shopify growth is fueled by a 52% year-over-year surge in specialized apps, which rose from 11,600 in Q1 2025 to over 17,600 in Q1 2026
- ✓ The growth slowdown to 13% between 2024 and 2025 was largely due to the fact that Shopify had implemented stricter quality checks on apps in 2024, focusing on quality over quantity
- ✓ The Shopify ecosystem expanded by 71% between early 2024 and Q1 2026, adding over 7,000 new apps in two years
- ✓ Growth is driven by rising demand for AI‑powered commerce tools and broader developer engagement beyond core e‑commerce
- ✓ Shopify is evolving from a simple storefront provider into a full digital infrastructure for global commerce, enabling retail innovation and customization on a massive scale
- ✓ The surge in apps increases market competition and makes app discovery and quality assurance more important than ever.

- ✓ Email/SMS marketing apps (Klaviyo, Omnisend, Mailchimp) continue to be essential merchant tools.
